detail.overview: The Intex Laptop Stand is the ideal partner for your everyday work and study sessions. Its durable metal and silicone construction ensures strength, while the foldable and lightweight design makes it easy to carry anywhere. With 7 adjustable height levels and a stable triangular structure, it provides ergonomic comfort for long hours. The hollow base allows continuous airflow to prevent laptop overheating, while anti-slip silicone grips keep your device secure. A smart choice for modern professionals and students alike.
features: Made with durable metal and silicone material
Foldable and portable for easy carrying
Stable triangular support for steady balance
7-level adjustable height for comfort and ergonomics
Hollow base design to prevent laptop overheating
Anti-slip silicone grips for added safety
